description: MCP server audit: connects to a remote MCP server (or takes its tool list), grades it A-F for tool poisoning, hidden Unicode, raw command/path inputs, destructive tools without annotations, name shadowing and insecure transport. Use before connecting an agent to an MCP server you did not write, or when a user asks whether an MCP server is safe. Pass url (Streamable HTTP; initialize and tools/list are called, nothing is invoked) or tools[] from your own tools/list for stdio servers. Returns grade A-F, score 0-100, verdict, server {name, version, protocolVersion, https, auth}, toolCount, findings[] {rule, severity, message, tool, evidence} and tools[] {name, risk, findings}. Any tool-poisoning finding caps the grade at D. Not charged when the server is down or needs auth. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls, no wallet needed.

headers.description: With url: headers to send, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer ..."}. Used for the audit only, never stored

instructions.description: With tools[]: the server's instructions string from initialize

tools.description: Instead of url: the server's tools as returned by tools/list (for stdio servers or servers behind auth)

url.description: Remote MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP), e.g. https://example.com/mcp

name: scan_mcp

grade.description: A, B, C, D or F

auth.description: none (tools listed without credentials), required or unknown

title: MCP server audit
